purpose: Owner-approved true side-profile replacement for decorative hero and campaign cutouts; not inventory photography.

prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent automotive website banner cutout. Generate ONE vehicle only: a silver Audi Q7 SUV, nose pointing RIGHT. CRITICAL CAMERA: exact full 90-degree SIDE ELEVATION, camera perfectly perpendicular to the side doors, at wheel-hub height, orthographic or very long lens. Show the entire near side from bumper to bumper, both near-side wheels as perfect circles with equal size and aligned axles. ZERO front or rear three-quarter perspective: the front grille surface and rear tailgate surface must NOT be visible. Do not show the far-side wheels. Photo-real premium automotive studio photography, detailed believable materials, realistic reflections, no stylization. Entire vehicle contained, level ground baseline, centered tightly with modest transparent padding, landscape 1536x1024. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background; no floor, no scene, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard painted in; very restrained contact shadow immediately below tyres only. No added text, captions, badges, numbers, watermarks or people. This is an illustrative marketing asset, not an inventory listing photo. Consistent neutral soft studio light. The exact broadside profile is more important than any other instruction.
